label: Ear tip point

provenance.source: species-head-spec.md section 3.1 #16 (anchor ratios sections 2/3.2, preset formula section 3.0)

range.endpoint_anchor: tip radius index: 0.50 = 0 (neutral base); span 0.45 -> -100 = 0.05, +100 = 0.95 (preset value = 100 x (species ratio - 0.50) / 0.45)

region.mask_rule: ear part meshes L/R, tip region only, mirrored; bone layer of the layered head stack

semantics: Tip rounding <-> point, as a tip radius index (cat +35, fox +30 pointed; lion -60, panther -50 rounded). Continuous part only: the tip FAMILIES (fully round / pointed / lynx tufts / fold-ear) are discrete ear part variants, not slider values (spec section 3.4). A bone-layer slider in the layered head stack (blueprint section 7.4).
